ACCESSIBILITY

Navigating HeyDock
more easily.

Accessibility features built into this site, known limitations, and how to report problems.

Plan your projectExplore services

FEATURES PRESENT

What the current site includes.

  • Skip link to main content
  • Keyboard-operable navigation, including Escape to close the mobile menu
  • Visible focus styles
  • Labelled form controls and native validation
  • Enquiry sending, success and error status messages
  • Responsive layouts and touch-friendly controls
  • Reduced-motion preferences respected for decorative motion
  • Software catalogue result counts announced for filters

This list describes implemented features. It is not a claim of WCAG conformance or a completed accessibility audit.

KNOWN LIMITATIONS

Honest constraints.

  • No formal third-party accessibility audit has been completed for this release.
  • Custom select disclosures progressively enhance native selects; if enhancement fails, native controls remain.
  • Complex service pages are text-heavy; structure relies on headings and lists rather than a separate easy-read edition.
  • PDF or other downloadable policy packs are not yet published; when added they will need their own accessibility review.

REPORT A PROBLEM

How to contact us.

If you encounter a barrier, email or write via the enquiry form. Please include the page URL, the device/browser if known, and what you were trying to do. We will acknowledge the report through the same channel and aim to assess a practical fix or workaround.
